strongest_angle: Examine the October 2026 findings by investigatory powers commissioner Lord Leveson detailing how MI5 submitted false evidence across three courts to protect a violent neo-Nazi informant known as Agent X.

key_facts.fact: An investigation by the Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office (IPCO) revealed that MI5 gave false evidence to three separate courts regarding the violent neo-Nazi informant known as Agent X.
Investigatory powers commissioner Lord Leveson stated that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy is as serious as anything he has ever dealt with.
The IPCO report found that one senior MI5 officer lied repeatedly while another misled his own colleagues and lied about what he was told regarding Agent X.
In September 2026, MI5 accepted for the first time that evidence based on lies was given to three courts while defending the violent neo-Nazi spy.

numbers.label: Number of courts misled by MI5
